entities.summary: Akeel Jamael Morris is an American Virgin Islander professional baseball pitcher for the Mumbai Cobras of Baseball United. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Mets, Atlanta Braves, and Los Angeles Angels. He was drafted by the Mets in the 10th round of the 2010 MLB draft, and made his MLB debut with them in 2015.
